examples.quote: However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and
Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.

operations.name: post_disposal_retention_effect_v2
operations.question: 判断供应窗口是否明示处置后的有限留存许可或留存禁止。备份例外只覆盖其明示材料；不得仅因要求处置全部材料就选择留存禁止。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“However, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, 1) neither party will be required to delete electronic Confidential Information stored in back-up/archival storage in accordance with its policies, provided that any such retained Confidential Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this Confidentiality Agreement until it is destroyed by the receiving party; and” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.”

rationale: 本次增量把瓶颈从整窗复合档案改为可独立绑定的来源字段：披露效力、接收者角色、角色所有权、need-to-know、保密保障和必要范围分别读取；处置动作连接、返还触发、销毁触发、返还材料、销毁材料和留存效果分别读取。组合层据此可表达“请求时返还、项目结束时销毁”、受书面授权限制的替代动作、不同动作的不同材料范围，以及备份或单一留档资格，而不把它们压缩成一个可错误笛卡尔展开的档案。规划器先做完整来源定位，同时根据当前文本中的角色、规范模态、动作、触发及紧邻例外生成稳定小窗；因此错误的宽泛 absence 读值不会阻止明显候选进入精读。该方案不使用来源、公司或原生标签分支，不把引用或模型选择视为来源真值，不从 unknown、unread 或缺失字段推出否定，也不声称 U 已运行或发生表示碰撞。现有21/48损失只是旧候选的已知结果；本提案尚未执行，不能宣称零误差或确定改进，残余错误应由实际安装后的同一 TRAIN 约束报告。
